Notification Status Viewer

Check the delivery status of patron hold and overdue notices sent by the library's automated notification system.

The Viewer shows every notification the system has attempted to deliver — holds ready for pickup, overdue reminders, and other notices — along with whether they were successfully sent, are pending, or failed. You can look up a specific patron by name or barcode, narrow by date, filter by status, and drill into individual notification details.

💡
Results default to Yesterday. Switch the Date Range to All Time (or pick a custom range) to see older notifications.

Searching & Filtering

Search box

Type any part of a patron name, barcode, item title, or item barcode and press Enter or click Search. The search is case-insensitive and works across all visible fields.

Date Range

Use the quick-range dropdown to pick a preset period — Yesterday, Today, Last 7 Days, This Month, Last Month, or All Time — or enter a custom start and end date. The date applies to the notification's sent timestamp.

Status pills

Toggle the ✓ Delivered, ⏱ Pending, and ✕ Failed pills to include or exclude each status. Click a pill once to activate only that status; click it again to deactivate. Click Search after changing pills to refresh the results.

Advanced Filters

Click Show Advanced Filters to reveal two additional dropdowns:

  • Notification Type — filter by Hold, 1st Overdue, 2nd Overdue, etc.
  • Delivery Method — filter by TXT Messaging, Phone, Email, and other configured methods.

Click Apply Filters to run the search, or Clear Filters to reset all filters and show all recent notifications.

Reading the Results Table

Results are sorted by Date Sent (most recent first) by default. Click any column header to re-sort. The count at the top shows how many notifications match your current filters.

Column What it shows
Patron Patron name (last, first) and library card barcode.
Item Full title of the item plus its item barcode.
Type Notification type — Hold, 1st Overdue, 2nd Overdue, etc.
Method Delivery method icon — speech bubble (TXT), phone (voice), or envelope (email).
Status ✓ Delivered, ⏱ Pending, or ✕ Failed.
Date Sent Date and time the notification was dispatched.

Click any row to open the Notification Details modal with the full record and, for failed notices, actionable guidance.

Notification Details

Clicking a row opens a details modal. It shows patron name and barcode, item title and barcode, notification type, contact info (phone number or email used), delivery method, and the current status message.

The modal header includes a copy icon (two overlapping squares) — click it to copy a plain-text summary of the notification to your clipboard, useful for pasting into a patron record or support note.

💡
For failed notifications, the What to do section tells you exactly what to ask the patron so the issue can be resolved — for example, which number to text to opt in to notifications.

Notification Statuses

✓ Delivered

The notification was successfully sent to the patron's phone or email. For text messages, delivery is confirmed by the carrier. For email, it means the message was accepted by the receiving mail server.

⏱ Pending

The notification has been dispatched but delivery confirmation has not yet been received. Text message confirmations can take up to 24 hours. If a message stays Pending for more than a day, it may have been silently dropped by the carrier.

✕ Failed

Delivery failed. Common reasons include:

  • Phone Number Unreachable — the number is not accepting texts; the patron needs to opt in.
  • Invalid Phone Number — the number on file is not a valid mobile number.
  • Email Bounced — the email address on file is undeliverable.
  • No Contact Info — the patron has no notification preference or contact info configured.

Open the detail modal for the specific remediation steps for each failure type.

Delivery Methods

The Viewer supports three delivery channels. The method icon in the results table indicates which channel was used for each notification.

💬 TXT Messaging SMS text sent to the patron's mobile number via the library's texting platform. Delivery confirmation typically arrives within minutes, though can take up to 24 hours.
📞 Phone (Voice) Automated phone call placed to the patron's primary phone number. The call plays a recorded message about the hold or overdue item.
✉️ Email Notification sent to the patron's email address on file. Email delivery is generally instant but may be filtered to spam.

Handling Failed Notifications

When a notification fails, the detail modal includes a What to do section with specific next steps. Here are the most common failure scenarios:

Text Message: Phone Number Unreachable

The patron's number is valid but is blocking automated texts. Ask the patron to:

  1. Text HELP to 1-555-544-9975 to verify they can receive texts from that number.
  2. Add 1-555-544-9975 to their contacts list so future texts aren't blocked.
  3. If they receive no response, ask them to update their notification preference in their account settings or at the circulation desk.

Text Message: Invalid Phone Number

The number on file cannot receive texts (e.g., it's a landline). Ask the patron to update their phone number in their Polaris account or at the desk, and set a notification preference that matches a valid mobile number.

No Contact Info on File

The patron has no notification preference configured in Polaris. Ask them to add a phone number or email address and select a preferred notification method.

⚠️
A failed notification does not mean the patron was not notified — check whether the system may have attempted a different method (e.g., also sent email). Review all rows for that patron using the search box.

Tips & Shortcuts

Search by patron barcode

Type the full patron barcode (e.g., 20000448634748) in the search box to instantly pull up all notifications for that patron across all dates.

Search by item barcode

Type the item barcode to see all notifications sent for a specific copy — useful if a patron says they never received a notice for a particular item.

Check "All Time" first

If a patron says they never received a notification, switch Date Range to All Time and search by their barcode before assuming no notice was sent.

Copy to clipboard

The copy icon in the detail modal header copies a formatted plain-text summary you can paste directly into a patron record, email, or support ticket.

✅
This viewer is read-only — browsing and searching never changes any data. You can filter, sort, and drill into records freely without affecting patron accounts or notification history.
